setup: CREATE TEMP SEQUENCE host_schema_calls; CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.host_pair(bigint) RETURNS TABLE(n bigint,label text) LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE AS $$ BEGIN PERFORM nextval('pg_temp.host_schema_calls'); RETURN QUERY SELECT i::bigint, 'row-' || i::text FROM pg_catalog.generate_series(0,$1-1) i; END $$

cases.name: empty_outer
cases.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 2 AS k WHERE FALSE) v, LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(k)

cases.name: bare_lateral
cases.query: SELECT n,label FROM (VALUES(1),(2)) v(k), LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(k) ORDER BY n,label

cases.name: qualified_star
cases.query: SELECT h.* FROM (VALUES(2)) v(k), LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(k) h ORDER BY n

cases.name: partial_alias
cases.query: SELECT h.* FROM (VALUES(2)) v(k), LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(k) h(x) ORDER BY x

cases.name: ordinality
cases.query: SELECT h.* FROM (VALUES(2)) v(k), LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(k) WITH ORDINALITY h ORDER BY n

cases.name: rows_from
cases.query: SELECT h.* FROM (VALUES(2)) v(k), LATERAL ROWS FROM(pg_temp.host_pair(k),pg_temp.host_pair(k-1)) WITH ORDINALITY h(a,b,c,d,ord) ORDER BY a

cases.name: derived
cases.query: SELECT h.* FROM (VALUES(2)) v(k), LATERAL (SELECT * FROM pg_temp.host_pair(k)) h ORDER BY n

cases.name: materialized_cte
cases.query: SELECT h.* FROM (VALUES(1),(2)) v(k), LATERAL (WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM pg_temp.host_pair(k)) SELECT * FROM c) h ORDER BY n,label

cases.name: empty_left_join
cases.query: SELECT k,h.* FROM (VALUES(0),(1)) v(k) LEFT JOIN LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(k) h ON true ORDER BY k

cases.name: on_predicate
cases.query: SELECT k,h.* FROM (VALUES(1),(2)) v(k) JOIN LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(k) h ON n=1

cases.name: where_predicate
cases.query: SELECT n,label FROM (VALUES(2)) v(k), LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(k) h WHERE n>0

cases.name: aggregate
cases.query: SELECT sum(n) AS n FROM (VALUES(1),(2)) v(k), LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(k)

cases.name: bounded_first
cases.query: SELECT h.* FROM (VALUES(1000000),(2)) v(k), LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(k) h LIMIT 1

cases.name: nested_calls
cases.query: SELECT b.* FROM (VALUES(2)) v(k), LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(k) a, LATERAL pg_temp.host_pair(a.n+1) b ORDER BY b.n,b.label
